findings.text: AC-1: browser-UI (format/size validation, error messages). AC-2: browser-UI (dimension validation). AC-3: no-UI (S3 backend). AC-4: no-UI (DB backend). AC-5: browser-UI (delete button). AC-6: native-mobile-UI (iOS picker, Android picker). AC-7: browser-UI (drag-drop + file input). All user-facing ACs mapped to screens.

Design language: Precision Technical dark theme. Background #0a0a0f, primary indigo #6366f1, Space Grotesk + JetBrains Mono, 8pt scale, border-radius 8px, left indigo accent bar. Follows project tokens (docs/design/KEEL-UI-E2E-tokens.css, KEEL-UI-E2E-onboarding-form-mockup.html).

WCAG 2.1 AA: error #f87171 on #0a0a0f = 5.7:1 contrast (>4.5:1). Focus states on all buttons. Keyboard Tab navigation. Alt text on avatar. prefers-reduced-motion @media rule required in phase 5 (SC 2.3.3).
Responsive design: 375px (mobile), 768px (tablet), 1200px (desktop). Drop zone scales; file input button and OR divider reflow below on mobile.
Design tokens: Space Grotesk (heading), JetBrains Mono (code), primary #6366f1, secondary #8b5cf6, error #f87171, success #10b981, disabled #6b7280. No hardcoded values.
All 9 component states rendered: idle, hover, drag-over, uploading (progress bar), success, error variants (format, size, dimensions, server). State switcher toggle in HTML mockup for testing.
HTML mockup: docs/design/BASELINE-002-profile-upload-mockup.html. Self-contained (inline CSS, Google Fonts CDN). No build required. Open directly in browser.
iOS: PHPickerViewController with HEIC→JPEG conversion (0.8 quality). Android: ACTION_GET_CONTENT image/* with bitmap dimension check. Specs in mockup header. OS-provided picker, no custom HTML.

All 5 items true: story_alignment (design aligns with 7 ACs), wcag_2_1_aa (5.7:1 contrast, focus, keyboard, alt text), responsive_design (375/768/1200px), design_tokens (project tokens, no hardcodes), palette_typography (5 colors, 2 font families).
AC-3 (S3 storage) and AC-4 (DB schema) descoped from UI design. Both are backend infrastructure. No user-facing surface. Documented explicitly as non-UI.
OPEN-2: Image resizing (non-blocking phase 4). OPEN-3: S3 region/CDN (non-blocking phase 3, blocking phase 5). OPEN-4: Soft vs permanent delete (non-blocking). Carried forward from phase 2.

Primary path: drag-drop zone with progress bar. Secondary path: file input button with OR divider. Success: avatar updates, 'Remove photo' button appears. Error: inline alert box with icon, message, code.

decisions: AC-3 (S3) and AC-4 (DB) are backend-only; descoped from UI design phase.
Drag-drop zone primary; file input secondary with OR divider.
Project design tokens used throughout; no hardcoded values.
Platform flows (iOS/Android) documented as native specs; no custom HTML.
